plugin.name: BakerING
plugin.description:
Editor support for Baker recipe files, making interaction wiring easier to understand at a glance.

Configuration

All features can be toggled independently under Settings → Tools → BakerING.

Features

  • Producer Highlighting — Place the caret on any interaction reference to automatically highlight every other interaction in the file that produces an ingredient required by the focused interaction. Uses the standard Highlight Usages in File mechanism (Ctrl+Shift+F7 / ⌘⇧F7). Enabled by default.
  • Documentation Popup Ingredients — Appends Baker ingredient info (inputs, outputs, and which interactions produce each input) to the Quick Documentation popup shown when hovering over an interaction class inside of(...) or inside a Class[] array literal. Ingredient types are shown as clickable links that navigate to the source class or its implementation. Enabled by default.
  • Interaction Ingredients — Compact inline hint next to each interaction reference showing its required input ingredients and produced output ingredients, e.g. ← orderId, customerId → OrderPlaced. Hover the hint to see a tooltip with full ingredient names, types, and which other interactions in the recipe produce each input. Disabled by default.
  • Interaction Ingredients (Expanded) — Alternative to the compact view, rendered at the end of the line with types alongside names, e.g. ← orderId: String, customerId: UUID → OrderPlaced: OrderOutcome. If both are enabled, Expanded takes precedence. Disabled by default.
  • Dependency Graph Popup — A small dependency-analyzer icon appears next to each interaction reference. Hover the icon to reveal a graph showing the interaction's inputs (with their producer interactions or external sources) and outputs in a three-column diagram. Producer boxes are clickable and navigate to the implementation class. Click the icon itself to jump straight to the interaction's implementation. Enabled by default.
plugin.change-notes:
v1.0.7

  • Fix — Clicking a node in the Recipe Graph (or a producer in the Dependency Graph Popup) no longer briefly freezes the IDE on large, multi-module projects — class resolution now happens off the UI thread.
  • Fix — Hovering the Dependency Graph Popup icon no longer freezes the IDE while it resolves the interaction.
  • Fix — Recipe Graph rendering errors are now logged to idea.log (instead of silently leaving the graph blank), with an on-screen message telling you to check the log and retry.
  • Dependency Graph Popup — Clicking the icon now jumps straight to the interaction's implementation, instead of requiring the hover popup to open first.
